filmer.beskrivning: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.
The mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge.
The exploration of Arthur Fleck, a man disregarded by society, is not only a gritty character study, but also a broader cautionary tale.
From adolescence to adulthood, I SWEAR delivers hilarious and poignant details, exploring Tourette’s, a condition that remains largely undiagnosed and misunderstood.

filmer.titel: Harry Potter and The Deathly Hallows - Part 2
filmer.beskrivning: The motion picture event of the generation comes to a close in the second part of the final chapter in the monumental Harry Potter series.
When playboy tennis pro Tony Wendice discovers his rich wife, Margo, is having an affair with handsome American Mark Halliday, he devises an ingenious plot to murder her.
A mythic and emotionally charged hero's journey, Dune tells the story of Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding.

filmer.titel: What Ever Happened To Baby Jane?
filmer.beskrivning: Bette Davis and Joan Crawford star as two aging sisters – both former celebrities--bound together in a psychopathic relationship by their mutual dependency, jealousy and hatred in this classic, shocking thriller.
The band of heroic renegades must defend the galaxy — and one of their own.

When two strangers – tennis star Guy Haines and wealthy but deranged young Bruno Anthony – happen to meet on a train from Washington to New York, the conversation casually turns to a possibly perfect crime: what if each committed a murder for the other?

In Chinese folklore, a “yao” is an animal spirit. Pig Yao, a wild young pig from Langlang Mountain, dreams of joining the King’s Cave. But after offending the monarch, he’s forced to leave and teams up with Toad Yao, Weasel Yao and Orangutan Yao to form a scripture-seeking fellowship.

filmer.titel: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows - Part 1
filmer.beskrivning: In the first part of the seventh and final adventure, Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on their perilous mission to track down
Sandra Bullock stars in this heart-pounding thriller set in the infinite and unforgiving realm of deep space.
Following a bachelor party, three friends of the prospective groom realise he has gone missing and that they cannot remember the previous evening.
As a serial killer terrifies San Francisco, four investigators search for the murderer. The case will become an obsession as their careers are built and destroyed by the endless trail of clues.

filmer.regissor: Joachim Trier, Lars Thomas Skare, Sunniva Sollied Møller
filmer.beskrivning: An intimate exploration of family, memories, and the reconciliatory power of art.
Emmet is mistakenly identified as The Special, the key to saving the world.
Ralph sets out to prove that he is a true hero in his arcade.
Washed-up revolutionary Bob exists in a state of stoned paranoia, surviving with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and she goes missing, Bob scrambles to find her.
The road to redemption is not something you can travel alone.

filmer.titel: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
filmer.beskrivning: Harry Potter returns to Hogwarts for his sixth year--to face a growing danger that may be more than a match for his strengthening powers as a wizard.
A powerful true story, Just Mercy follows young lawyer Bryan Stevenson and his history-making battle for justice.
A chance encounter draws a man into his past in an inexplicable way.
Three high school students explode with a violence and sexuality that their parents cannot understand.
Twin brothers return to their hometown to discover that evil is waiting for them.

Man-su sees his perfect life unravel after a corporate takeover leaves him jobless. As months pass and job prospects dwindle, desperation takes hold. Faced with losing everything, he devises a chilling solution: eliminate his rivals - literally!

filmer.titel: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
filmer.beskrivning: A summer has passed since Harry's encounter with the Dark Lord, and Harry returns to learn that the wizarding community remains in denial about Voldemort's return.

"We are not alone..." Two-time Academy Award-winner Jodie Foster and Hollywood's brightest new star, Matthew McConaughey, shine in this spellbinding drama of a dedicated astronomer's quest to make first Contact.
Renowned "consulting detective" Sherlock Holmes has a reputation for solving the most complex mysteries.
As the world fell, young Furiosa is snatched from the Green Place of Many Mothers.
Wade Watts is hurled into a reality-bending treasure hunt through the OASIS, a virtual reality universe, in hopes of winning an immense fortune.

filmer.titel: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
filmer.beskrivning: The game is afoot once more! Robert Downey Jr. and Jude Law reprise their roles as Holmes and Watson.
The Protagonist journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a mission.

At 32, Alice Hyatt watches her dreams slipping away. Instead of a career as a singer, she has an abusive husband, an ill-mannered son and a life in Oklahoma. But when her husband dies in an accident, Alice heads west to pursue her dreams, working as a lounge singer along the way.
Ben Affleck stars as a math savant who's closer to numbers than people. He works for the world's most dangerous criminals.
Mariano De Santis is the President of the Italian Republic. As his term draws to a close, amid uneventful days, two final duties arise: deciding on two delicate petitions for a presidential pardon.
Starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande, the untold story of the witches of Oz arrives on your screen as a generation-defining cinematic event.
James Franco transforms the tragicomic true-story of aspiring filmmaker and infamous Hollywood outsider Tommy Wiseau into a celebration of friendship, artistic expression, and dreams pursued.
LEGO Batman has to drop his lone vigilante thing and try to work with others.

filmer.titel: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
filmer.beskrivning: Newt Scamander's magical beasts are inadvertently let loose in 1926 New York.

In the not-so-distant future, David, a robot with actual human feelings, especially a never-ending love for his "mother," Monica, is adopted as a substitute for her real son, who, afflicted with an incurable disease, remains in "cryo-stasis".
After a biological war, Robert Neville is the last healthy human living on Earth, but he is not alone.
Johanne, 17, documents her crush on a teacher. Her family is captivated—but what really happened?

Taxi driver Koji Usami works long hours to support his family, but rising expenses leave him increasingly strained. Filling in for a colleague, he picks up 85-year-old Sumire Takano in Shibamata, who asks to be driven to Hayama to enter a nursing home.
A disillusioned Englishman who goes to work in a school in a divided Argentina in 1976 finds his life transformed when he rescues an orphaned penguin from the beach.

Anker is released after 15 years in prison for robbery. Anker’s brother, Manfred, is the only one who knows where the money from the robbery is located. But in the meantime he has been affected by a mental challenge that makes him no longer aware of where it is hidden.
A single woman seeks intimacy without commitment until two men challenge her views on love and freedom.
Eun-ho boards a bus to his hometown, while Jeong-won, on a break from college, sets off with no destination in mind. A chance seating brings them together and a quiet connection grows.
Based on a true story that follows two Miami stoners who exploit a little-known government initiative during the Iraq War that allows small businesses to bid on U.S. Military contracts.
An orphaned violin prodigy finds the courage to defy her fate after meeting Vivaldi.
Justin Kemp finds himself struggling with a serious moral dilemma.

Four girls, Alma, Erika, Angelika, and Lenka, each spend their youth on the same farm in northern Germany. As the home evolves over a century, echoes of the past linger in its walls. Though separated by time, their lives begin to mirror each other.

In Mumbai, two Malayali nurses and a struggling cook navigate love, identity, and societal pressures. Prabha longs for her estranged husband, Anu hides an interfaith romance, and Parvathy faces eviction.
A father, accompanied by his son, goes looking for his missing daughter at a desert rave in North Africa.
It centers around Alex, the president’s son, and Britain’s Prince Henry whose long-running feud threatens to drive a wedge in U.S./British relations.

Jason Sudeikis stars in this buzz-worthy comedy as a small-time suburban pot-dealer who likes to keep a low profile. When he's jumped by some gutter punks who steal his cash and his stash, he finds himself in deep trouble with his supplier.
You are cordially invited to experience a new kind of love story...

How well do we know ourselves when making decisions? What if multiple versions of us had their own opinions? FolleMente is a romantic comedy diving into the minds of Piero and Lara, revealing hidden thoughts and the inner battles we all face.
Jason Bateman and Rachel McAdams star as Max and Annie, whose weekly couples Game Night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother, Brooks, arranges a murder mystery party.
Three friends devise a convoluted and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their employers...permanently.

In Seoul, three elderly loners, Woo-sik, Hyoung-jun and Hwa-jin struggle to survive by collecting cardboard and selling vegetables. United by poverty and hunger, they hatch a bold plan: dine at upscale restaurants and slip away without paying.

Based on the bestselling novel by Jonathan Safran Foer and adapted by screenwriter Eric Roth, this prestige drama follows a nine-year-old boy who finds a mysterious key that once belonged to his father, a victim of the September 11th terrorist attacks.
Before a life-changing challenge, Nino must complete two missions that reconnect him with the world and himself.
A stuntman must track down a missing movie star, solve a conspiracy, and win back the love of his life while still doing his day job in this action-packed thrill ride.
To live in Barbie Land is to be a perfect being in a perfect place. Unless you have a full-on existential crisis. Or you're a Ken.
Agent John Connolly persuades Irish mobster James "Whitey" to collaborate with the FBI and eliminate a common enemy.
Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are best friends, fighting crime in Metropolis side by side.
Céline is expecting her first child but she is not pregnant. It is Nadia, her wife, who will give birth to their daughter.
Storks deliver babies...or at least they used to. Now they deliver packages for global internet giant Cornerstore.com.
Jim Carrey stars with Bradley Cooper, Zooey Deschanel, John Michael Higgins, and Terence Stamp in the story of a man who, with a single word, becomes a most extraordinary Yes Man.

In a near-future Tokyo where the threat of a catastrophic earthquake pervades daily life, two rabble-rousing best friends are about to graduate high school. Stuck between the oppressive security system and a darkening national political situation, the two respond in contrasting ways.
Set against the sun-bleached grit of Los Angeles, Crime 101 weaves the tale of an elusive jewel thief (Chris Hemsworth) whose string of heists along the 101 freeway have mystified police.
A young ramen chef travels from Japan to Singapore, uncovering family secrets through food and culture.
Carla Simón’s new drama follows an orphaned teen meeting her father’s family and uncovering her parents’ hidden past.
The unlikely hero, Mickey Barnes has found himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job... to die, for a living.
Two friends meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.
Thomas and Ane, amid a divorce, haven't told their children. Ane suffers a stroke when Thomas move in with his girlfriend.

filmer.titel: Teen Titans Go! to the Movies
filmer.beskrivning: Teen Titans GO! to the Movies finds our egocentric Super Heroes in their first feature film.
In this refreshingly unique comedy, two girls, PJ and Josie, start a fight club as a way to lose their virginities to cheerleaders. And their bizarre plan works!
Stefani heads home to track down the one person who might be able to save her family.
Experience this live-action reimagining of the beloved animated classic.

filmer.titel: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
filmer.beskrivning: The Mandalorian and young Grogu embark on a mission to protect the galaxy.
When struggling furniture salesman Clark discovers a hidden portal in the basement of his store, he becomes trapped in an infinite labyrinth of buzzing fluorescents and winding yellow halls.
Smallfoot turns a myth upside down when a bright young yeti finds something he thought didn't exist—a human. News of this "smallfoot" throws the simple yeti community into an uproar.
Early in the morning of April 9, 1940, the alarm goes off and the Danish army is put on high alert. The Germans have crossed the border and Denmark is at war with Europe's strongest military power.

filmer.titel: Rally – from Paris to the Pyramids
filmer.beskrivning: An untested invention, a curious Solan and a top-notch lawnmower on a wild ride lead to the mayor banishing the trio from Flåklypa.
Fren, an HR worker at a demanding company, secretly faces pregnancy and a difficult choice.
After her boyfriend dies in a car crash, piano student Laura finds refuge with a witness’s family, but grows suspicious.
Unexpected encounters lead two married men to question sexuality, gender and their sense of self.
Based on a true story, Last Breath follows divers as they battle the raging elements to rescue a crewmate trapped deep below the ocean's surface.
As Niki explores her mother’s past, she discovers troubling inconsistencies between Etsuko’s mementoes and her recollections, leading her to question the truths hidden within their family story.

filmer.titel: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
filmer.beskrivning: Lines are drawn as love and loyalty are tested, even among the truest friends and family, in a wizarding world.
As Nora unexpectedly finds herself single at the age of 40, she opts for single motherhood with the help of a sperm donor.
An astronaut travels to the edges of the solar system to find his father.
Four top fighter pilots, now retired, are brought back into service to assist NASA during a major satellite crisis.
Based on a true story, the New Line Cinema comedy Tag shows how far some guys will go to be the last man standing

filmer.titel: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
filmer.beskrivning: Renée Zellweger returns as her iconic rom-com heroine, Bridget Jones, as Bridget, now a widowed mother, forges a new path toward life and love.
Sophie has just one wish to make her wedding perfect: to have her father walk her down the aisle. Now she just has to figure out who he is!
The world of Pokémon comes to life! The first-ever live-action Pokémon adventure.
A CIA decoder hunts for his wife’s killers, his intelligence as his weapon.

filmer.titel: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
filmer.beskrivning: The heroes of Bricksburg inan all new action-packed adventure to save their beloved city.
Ivy-League's picture-perfect world verges on collapse after discovering she's pregnant.

Kaya has always wanted to be just like all the other cells in her part of the body. So, when the others begin preparing for the great quest, and she’s left behind - her heart breaks. Determined to find her own way, Kaya sets off, alone.

filmer.titel: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
filmer.beskrivning: Héra must summon the will to lead the resistance.
Mai, a rising J-Pop idol, risks everything when forbidden love shatters her purity image, sparking a courtroom battle.
Joe Deacon is sent to Los Angeles for what should have been a quick evidence-gathering assignment. Instead, he becomes embroiled in the search for a killer who is terrorizing the city.
A young woman must survive the night in the Virgil, a twisted lair filled with deadly traps and a demonic cult determined to make her their next offering in a brutal, darkly comic fight.

Mikkel and Louise take their daughters Sille and Ella on a well-deserved all-inclusive vacation to a Spanish island. Under the palm trees and with the Atlantic Ocean on the horizon, a week of peace and togetherness awaits. But the idyll is shattered when boats with refugees wash ashore on the beach.
Champions wage a brutal fight to stop Shao Kahn.
Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel reunite at Runway in this stylish sequel.
Lara goes in search of her dad's last-known destination. If she survives this perilous adventure, it could be the making of her, earning her the name Tomb Raider.

filmer.titel: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
filmer.beskrivning: Professor Albus Dumbledore knows Dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald is moving to seize control of the wizarding world.
After an embarrassing social media incident, influencer Hanna leaves the big city and returns to her hometown in Värmland.

filmer.regissor: Pierre LeDuc, Fabian Polack, Aaron Horvath, Michael Jelenic
filmer.beskrivning: In The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, Mario and crew blast off on an epic journey and encounter new worlds, iconic characters, and unexpected threats.
A dark romance fueled by passion and madness.
Lucy confides to Jane that she likes women.
A journalist's daughter returns, but something isn't right.
MMA fighter Cole Young seeks out Earth's greatest champions.
Dwayne Johnson stars as primatologist Davis Okoye, who shares an unshakable bond with the incredibly rare albino gorilla who has been in his care since he rescued the young orphan from poachers.

filmer.regissor: Charlie Bean, Paul Fisher, Bob Logan
filmer.beskrivning: The battle for Ninjago City calls to action young Lloyd, aka the Green Ninja, along with his friends, who are all secret warriors and LEGO Master Builders.
Decades later, the McMullens confront love and betrayal.
Jeanne, a 15-year-old orphan, is captivated by Cristina, the enigmatic star of a Snow Queen film shoot she witnesses.

filmer.titel: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
filmer.beskrivning: Pits Kong and Godzilla against a colossal threat hidden within our world.
An epic action adventure that pits Godzilla against some of the most popular monsters in pop culture history.
The Justice League have mysteriously vanished. Now it's up to the world's greatest super sleuths, Scooby and the gang, to solve the mystery and save our heroes.
Follows two crime bosses, Frank Costello and Vito Genovese.
New York City architect Natalie (Rebel Wilson) works hard to get noticed at her job but is more likely to be asked to deliver
Three mummies end up in present-day London and embark on a journey in search of an old ring belonging to the Royal Family.

A podcast host covering spooky content moves in to care for her dying mother. When sent recordings of a pregnant couple's paranormal encounters, she discovers their story parallels hers, each tape pushing her toward madness.
A romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.
A father and daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event.
A couple rents a house with their parents inhabited by a poltergeist.
Mina gets stranded in a forest in western Ireland.
Ben Mears returns to his hometown... only to discover it's being preyed upon by vampires.
Captain America must unravel a nefarious global plot and stop the Red Hulk.
The Hangover's Ed Helms and Zoolander's Owen Wilson headline this dysfunctional family comedy as a pair of brothers whose eccentric mother raised them to believe that their father died long ago.
When her husband suddenly dumps her, dedicated housewife Deanna turns regret into re-set by going back to college.
A lonely man turns to a visionary scientist to create a companion, and together they revive a murdered woman whose awakening unleashes chaos, rebellion and forbidden love.
The first full-length animated Scooby-Doo adventure for the big screen is the never-before told stories of Scooby-Doo.
Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the Overworld.
Two college freshmen who "Turkey Dump" with each of their highs school sweethearts.

Isabella's confidence slips when she learns that Simon, her great teenage love, is getting married to Isabella's childhood friend Molly, and that she is not even invited to the wedding. A part of Isabella's heart will always beat for Simon.
One of the most beloved rivalries in history is reignited when Jerry moves into New York City's finest hotel.
Finds Arthur Fleck institutionalized at Arkham awaiting trial.
Magic Mike Lane (Tatum) takes to the stage again after a lengthy hiatus, following a business deal that went bust, leaving him broke and taking bartender gigs in Florida.
Jason Statham and global action icon Wu Jing lead a daring research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean.

When a whistleblower uncovers unnatural behavior and mass deaths in wild salmon, marine biologist Johanne is sent to Norway's deepest fjord. But what starts as a routine mission in familiar territory quickly develops into something far more serious.
After a girl vanishes during a cursed game, her friend faces a repeating night of terror in a haunted amusement park, battling a relentless Red Person to break the cycle and save her.
At CASA GRANDE, a woman returns home as a land war erupts, forcing her to choose between revenge and redemption.
A sheriff and a U.S. Marshal set a trap for a dangerous outlaw.
It's Tunes versus Goons in the highest-stakes challenge of his life, that will redefine LeBron's bond with his son and shine a light on the power of being yourself.
An antique necklace with a sinister force threatens to destroy the Davis family.
Director Akira Kurosawa tells a vivid story of life, loss and renewal through a series of eight dreams.
